Kevin: quick one — Acero Health wants very non-standard terms for the pilot. They propose Net 180 with 50% upfront into an escrow account, then 25% at month 4 and 25% at month 9, plus a year-end usage true-up. They want the pilot to run on dedicated capacity and convert to a 12mo commitment if successful. cc @Sam (DealDesk) :thinking_face:
Maya (PSE): FYI security also asked for customer-managed KMS + SOC2 evidence for the pilot data. POC will need a dedicated pool. I ran rough infra numbers — shared below.
Sam (DealDesk): Net 180 + escrow is outside our standard. Need deal economics: total pilot value, expected conversion ARR, justification for credit risk. Also legal + finance sign-off required.
Kevin: Pilot economics: total pilot/licensing & support = $250,000. If they convert, anticipated first-year commit ~ $1.1M. They want a 25% discount for pilot->paid motion. Finance flagged credit risk so they requested escrow.
Alex (Eng): Dedicated pool doable. Estimated marginal infra cost for dedicated GPUs + support: ~$42,000 over 9 months (we calculated extra SRE on-call, scheduler overhead, and reserved GPU cost). We'll want config: 4xA100-sim nodes, burst to shared for spikes. Also recommend q4_8bit quant and aggressive batching to control tokens.
Kevin: Proposed invoice schedule (what Acero sent):
```
Invoice schedule:
- 50% (on PO) -> pay to escrow (NET 180)
- 25% -> milestone 2 (month 4)
- 25% -> milestone 3 (month 9)
- Year-end: usage true-up (net settlement within 60 days of true-up)
Notes: escrow release conditions tied to acceptance criteria in SOW.
```
Lina (CSM): We can own onboarding and acceptance SOW. Need clear success criteria for milestone payments. Legal needs to confirm escrow release conditions + liability.
Sam (DealDesk): DealDesk preliminary stance: we can consider a one-time exception for Net 180 on the pilot only if: (1) signed SOW + PO, (2) 50% deposited to escrow before kickoff, (3) Finance approves after credit check or corporate guarantor, (4) discount capped at 15% (we can't approve 25% without exec signoff). Also need indemnity language for escrow.
Kevin: Understood — I'll push back on discount to 20% but can accept 15% if required. I'll ask Acero for corp guarantee and fill out credit app.
Maya (PSE): Also note: customer expects support SLA during pilot (24/7 for on-call). That increases our ops cost; we should include a support fee line item.
Sam (DealDesk): action items for approval path:
- Kevin: collect credit app + confirm corp guarantee (if available)
- Legal: review escrow wording + SOW acceptance criteria (Sam will ping Legal)
- Finance: run credit exposure & flag wiring instructions
- Eng: confirm dedicated pool sizing and costs (Alex)
I'll create an internal approval thread and tag legal/finance. If finance greenlights and legal approves escrow language, DealDesk can approve Net 180 for pilot only and cap discount at 15%.
billing-bot: Invoice system note — created draft invoice tag `ESCROW-ACERO-1842`. Reminder: attach escrow account docs and PO before transitioning to 'send'.
Kevin: Thanks. I'll update customer: request credit app, propose 15% cap, ask for corporate guarantee and confirm escrow wiring details. Pinging @Sam (DealDesk) and @Lina (CSM) to expedite. :thumbsup:
Sam (DealDesk): I'll loop in Legal and Finance now, will aim to have recommendation in 48h. Marking this P0 for approval routing. :eyes:
notes: thread about Net 180 escrow + milestone invoicing for a pilot converting to a 12mo commitment; includes engineering cost estimates and dealdesk conditional approval
